name: TryAMM Shared Platform Backbone
purpose: Provide one authoritative layer for identity, entitlements, credits, provider costs, jobs, assets, rights, payouts, audit events and cross-vertical orchestration.
whyCritical: Without this layer, TryAMM verticals become separate islands with inconsistent balances, permissions, ownership, costs and audit history.
coreServices: Asset Vault + Digital DNA + Rights Vault
canonicalFlow: route to approved provider or internal worker
register Digital DNA and asset lineage
make output available to entitled surfaces
mustNot: maintain separate un-reconciled balances per vertical
call paid AI providers without authorization
store critical state only in memory
let verticals invent incompatible user identities
